# How can I find the collaborator code?

To see the collaborator code in your store, here are steps:

## STEP 1:&#x20;

Click on **"Settings"** on your bottom-left of your Shopify Admin:&#x20;

<figure><img src="/files/Ue5Vv7Czhj62jAuTcTiQ" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## STEP 2:

Choose **Users > Security** and then send us the code via Livechat

<figure><img src="/files/VlXDyl19sk6vLFSIZOTT" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
